findings.title: Default-FAIL verification contract is not satisfied
findings.description: The contract explicitly records required `regression` and `placeholder-scan` checks as `passes: false`. It also states that `spec_revision` is stale and deliberately leaves the obsolete digest in the authoritative field. The implementation therefore lacks a valid verification contract bound to the reviewed specification.

findings.title: The required evaluate-predicate fan-out is not exercised
findings.description: REQ-005 requires one real A2 `evaluate-predicate` invocation per Registry Capability × Project-Context component. The tests instead perform a bespoke component-name equality simulation over one capability and one component, then test only the downstream fragment consumer. Static substring checks cannot verify command invocation, Cartesian fan-out, trigger evaluation, or result interpretation, leaving the task's central enforcement path untested.

findings.title: The positive fixture uses a non-catalog upgrade reason
findings.description: The fixture supplies `financial_settlement`, but the specified twelve-token upgrade-reason catalog contains `payments` and does not contain `financial_settlement`. Because the skill contract says fragment reasons are already catalog-validated, this fixture cannot represent a valid upstream Capability-derived signal and does not establish the claimed compliant success path.
